text:
amy (SE): Quick sync on the Starlight POC timeline — final handoff is in 3 weeks. Need confirmation on infra networking window + CR owner for the Okta connector changes. Owners proposed: @kevin (ENG) for API throttling/perf, @sam (Infra) for firewall/egress, @jordan (SE) for deployment runbook. Can you ack and call out blockers? TL;DR: customer success criteria = sub-200ms p95 gen (512 tokens), Okta SAML + VPC peering, and audit logs in syslog format. Spreadsheet: https://go/repo/starlight-poc-sheet :spiral_calendar:

kevin (ENG): Ack. I can take API throttling + perf. Quick Q: can we reduce default max_tokens to 512 on their routes to keep costs down? Also will need a CR review for the throttling config. @oliver (ENG) can you help with perf test harness? :detective:

sam (Infra): Blocked on static egress IPs from cloud team. I filed cloud ticket #7892 — they said ETA EOD Tue for a static range. If they can’t provide static IP, we’ll need to stand up a NAT GW (adds ~1 day + cost).

jordan (SE): Working on the deployment runbook. Will post a draft by tomorrow morning. For SSO: they want Okta SAML with assertion consumer URL set to our proxy. Do we have a key rotation doc for SAML certs? @ops-team / @maria (CS)

maria (CS): We have a basic Okta guide but no formal cert rotation doc. I can pull the customer's SAML metadata tonight and confirm which attributes they expect. Also confirming they want per-request audit logs: request_id + model_name + latency (ms).

kevin (ENG): For perf: can we run a synthetic workload? I need a small loadgen cluster. Pinging @devops-bot to spin up 2x perf nodes in staging. Will run sweeps at 40 concurrent users and seq=512.

devops-bot: deploy request received — launching 2x perf nodes (staging-perf-01, staging-perf-02). ETA ~18m. Loadgen command:
```
python tools/loadgen.py --concurrency 40 --seq-len 512 --model r-instruct-7b --duration 600
```

oliver (ENG): Happy to review the CR. Keep it minimal: config toggle + unit tests. Ping me the diff and a short perf run log and I’ll prioritize.

sam (Infra): Also, customer requested a documented private key rotation policy for Private deployments. Ops team — can you own drafting that? It should list KMS integration steps for AWS KMS.

ops-team: We can draft the rotation policy. Quick Q: will customer use AWS KMS or HashiCorp? @amy (SE)

amy (SE): They’re on AWS. Ops, please draft steps for AWS KMS and include example rotation cron and a rollback plan. Thanks.

amy (SE): Timeline sanity check — is SSO + VPC peering + perf within 3 weeks realistic? Call out anything that forces a slip.

kevin (ENG): SSO + perf looks fine. VPC peering depends on the static egress IP answer. If cloud gives static IP, peering is ~2 days. If not, NAT fallback adds ~3 days to timeline.

jordan (SE): I’ll update the milestone sheet with two tracks (static-IP vs NAT-fallback) and mark the gating tickets. Will share link in this thread when done.

maria (CS): :thumbsup: I’ll assemble the customer-facing checklist for next Friday’s demo and include the SAML steps + audit log confirmation.

amy (SE): Quick CR ping — CR #4581 (connector/okta-saml). Please review by EOD Mon. If no objections we merge and queue a small canary rollout.

oliver (ENG): Reviewing now. So far only small nits; will post comments shortly.

devops-bot: Perf nodes ready: staging-perf-01, staging-perf-02. Loadgen started (run id: perf-30321-a).

sam (Infra): Once the perf run completes, please drop p95 snapshots and any raw traces here. @kevin

kevin (ENG): Will post snapshots + traces. Planning 3 x 10m sweeps with slightly different batching configs.

amy (SE): If we hit <200ms p95 we’re green. If not, fallback plan: try int8 quantization + bump batch size + re-run. Need signoff from customer for quantization change.

jordan (SE): Question for @maria — does the customer accept model quantization (int8) if it improves latency? We’ll need to show minimal regression on their evals.

maria (CS): They prefer no regression in output quality but are open to int8 **if** we show parity on our eval prompt suite. I’ll note that in the checklist.

amy (SE): Action items summary: Kevin — perf runs + CR; Sam — egress/static IP + NAT fallback plan; Jordan — runbook + milestone spreadsheet; Ops — key rotation doc for AWS KMS; Maria — customer checklist + SAML metadata. I’ll update the calendar invite and the POC owner list. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
